info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Statement Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Account Statement Retrieval API provides businesses with a streamlined method to access detailed financial statements for specific customer accounts. Through this API, users can retrieve comprehensive transaction histories and account summaries based on a given customer ID and account ID. This functionality is particularly useful for financial services and accounting firms that need to analyze customer activity and support audit processes. Typical consumers include financial analysts and customer service representatives who require timely access to account information for reporting and customer inquiries.

get.summary: Retrieve the statement for a specific customer account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the detailed statement for the specified account of a customer. It includes transaction history, account balance, and other relevant financial information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the account statement for a specific account. The request body must adhere to the defined schema structure to ensure the required data is correctly formatted and transmitted.

GetCustomerAccountStatementRequest.description: Request body schema for retrieving the account statement for a specific customer and account.

GetCustomerAccountStatementResponse_200.title: Statement Response

value.description: The string value representing the statement details.

GetCustomerAccountStatementResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving the statement of a specific account.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes the Bearer authentication method with JSON Web Tokens (JWT) to secure your API endpoints. Clients must include a valid JWT token in the Authorization header when making requests.
